products.title: Whispered Surprises Secret Message Candle
products.subtitle: Hand-Poured Soy Wax · Hidden Love Note Melts into View
products.concentration: 100% Golden Soy Wax with Wooden Wick
products.description: The viral secret message candle. As the pure golden soy wax warms, a custom embossed heartfelt love note slowly floats into view through the amber wax pool. Hand-poured in a textured frosted jar with an organic crackling wooden wick.
products.usageRitual: Trim the crackling wooden wick to 1/4 inch before each light. On first burn, let the wax melt evenly to the edges (approx. 2 hours) to avoid tunneling.

products.usageRitual: Light with a wooden match and allow the melt pool to reach all edges before extinguishing.

products.title: Oceanic Breeze Signature Tassel Extrait EDP
products.subtitle: Sea Salt · Crisp Citrus · Cedarwood Accord
products.description: A tribute to the untamed Mediterranean coast at sunrise. Oceanic Breeze marries crisp sun-drenched bergamot and ozone vapors with mineral sea salt and ancient cedarwood. Handcrafted in small artisanal batches with 35% pure extrait concentration for monumental sillage that lingers from dawn till deep into midnight.
products.usageRitual: Spray 2-3 times onto warm pulse points: inner wrists, base of the neck, and collarbone. Avoid rubbing to preserve top citrus notes. Layer with Fresh Citrus & Ozone Attar for an intensified 24-hour aquatic signature.

products.title: Aqua Noir Intense Tassel Flacon EDP
products.subtitle: Smoky Amber · Marine Accord · Bergamot
products.description: An enigmatic plunge into midnight waters. Aqua Noir blends deep marine undertones with spicy black pepper, smoky Indonesian patchouli, and rich midnight amber.
products.usageRitual: Apply directly onto pulse points and chest before evening events.

products.title: Fresh Citrus & Ozone Pure Crystal Attar
products.subtitle: Pure Concentrated Oil · 24+ Hr Longevity
products.description: Formulated in the ancient tradition of attar distillation without alcohol. Pure botanicals suspended in skin-loving jojoba and sandalwood oil.
products.usageRitual: Use the crystal wand to dot oil onto the inside of wrists, neck, and behind ears. Gently stroke onto beard or scarf fibers.

products.description: A royal coronation of rare blooms. Velvet Rose & Saffron layers prized Persian saffron threads with velvety crimson Damask roses and rich bourbon vanilla.
products.usageRitual: Spritz on collar, wrists, and hair ends for an enduring magnetic scent aura.

products.title: Birthday Candle — Strawberry Drip Petite Gateau

products.usageRitual: Trim the wick to 1/4 inch before burning. Burn on a heat-safe candle tray or coaster for clean melting.

products.description: Infused with intentions of peace and shielded warding, this handcrafted candle features the iconic blue Nazar eye embedded in serene ivory soy wax. Formulated to dispel negative energies and bring soothing clarity into any room.
products.usageRitual: Light during meditation, evening unwind rituals, or upon entering a new home to invite positivity and ward off ill vibes.

products.title: Rose Whimsy Heart-Melts Candle

products.description: A playful love affair in wax. Features a dreamy two-tone pink and ivory pour crowned with hand-crafted botanical wax hearts that melt gently into a pool of fragrant rose oil and vanilla.
products.usageRitual: Allow the top layer of hearts to slowly liquefy on the initial burn to unleash the rich floral extrait fragrance.
